notes: Plan overrides on top of the named preset. Keys under 'overrides' are applied with setattr after apply_preset and are never dropped. Keys under 'pending' belong to in-flight jobs: the builder applies each only when the stack's BuildPlan has the field, records it as skipped otherwise, and, when the stack still refuses it because a dependency (depends_on) has not landed, drops it for that build after a preflight and records why (--strict-pending turns that into a failure). 'inputs' names the file inputs the overrides point at; paths starting with '<stack>/' resolve inside the stack worktree the builder is given. Every choice and its evidence is in B76_U1_REPORT.md. | v2: f1 lineman ON (MyCareer composes), f2 Crib cut ON (with the custom intro), f5 16 reserves + 2 extra created teams ON (SEGA hang fixed, boot witnessed to the menu), c1 marks + sprite compose (espn_marks_2026 ON), p2 ESPN 2026 wipes and boards ON, z2 xemu display-list stability fix ON through all presets, z2 blank boot logo for every xbe_space layout, s12/s14 scorebug art, s15 records/possession/timeouts when it lands. | v3: custom_intro is Noah's 'montage final' edit (the v2 input, i1's candidate encode, was moved to the Trash with its sources at 2026-09-23 00:04). | v4: the full v3 disc BUGCHECKs while loading every game (3 of 3; KeBugCheckEx 0x1E, C0000005 at 0x8001DBD4, the 9/15 null-buffer read after a main-heap allocation failure). Bisect on the same stack: without the arena growth alone, BUGCHECK; without the Guardian overlay alone, BUGCHECK; without both, PASS. So v4 turns off reserves_16, created_teams_extra and guardian_overlay (with guardian_everyone_practice). They come back when memory is won back (for example a right-sized allocator or the research K128 path). | v5: with team_names_2026 on, the ROST team LABEL abbreviation becomes ARI, LA, LV and LAR (Cardinals, Chargers, Raiders, Rams); the engine builds the playbook file name from it ('%s-pb.iff', FUN_000628D0 from [[team+0x110]+4], found by e2), so a Rams game asks for LAR-pb.iff, the playbook slot stays empty and setup reads NULL+0x60 at 0xE06E3 (bugcheck 0x1E). Proved from the RAM snapshots (0xB307D0 = 'LAR-pb.iff' on the candidate, 'STL-pb.iff' on disc Z). Off until the option keeps the identity codes and renames only the labels. | v6: team_names_2026 back ON with job t1's fix (ac920b423): the four engine-key fields stay retail (label + identity abbreviations, asset code, identity nickname); only city names, city abbreviations and the Washington playbook label change. The stack also installs e1's historic-team release repair with the practice squad (703e89928), which fixes the ESPN 25th two-teams bug and the Wide Right loading freeze. | v7: espn25_rosters ON (e1 patch 2, 2207ffc60: build block lifted; composes with One-pool positions and the EDGE rename). The Wide Right loading freeze was the practice squad's stale-pointer bug, fixed by the historic-team release repair (703e89928).

Video build: v7 (8/8 stadiums in the lab) + historic_teams_quick_game (h1: 2/2 lab runs on v7 + the option). No updated rosters, no new moments (the new-moments engine is not lab-tested yet), no K128.

FINAL (draft, main 2026-09-23 19:00): the video recipe (v7 + historic_teams_quick_game) plus: modern_metlife (u2, on the stack 060472581, lab 2/2); the unlocks from k1 (k128_memory + k128_roster_heap with the 9-byte cap; k128_early only if proven), which bring back reserves_16, created_teams_extra 2 and guardian_overlay (off since v4 for memory) ONLY IF k1's U2 8-stadium series passes; espn25_more_moments (m1 engine + m2 data, rows 26 to 50); the 2026 teams (u1 + d1..d8: league visual project + league roster through build_ultimate_teams2026.py --project/--roster-edits); the 2026 field and wall art in every home stadium (u4, suggested key modern_venues_2026); every team's 2026 identity in MyNFL and Play Now (u3, key TBD); the fixes for Noah's two recordings (vb1..vb3, keys TBD where they add options).
